setupHint: Choose a password to encrypt the runner connection saved on this phone. The app locks whenever it goes into the background.
unlockHint: Your desktop keeps running while this phone is locked.
length: At least 12 characters. Keep it somewhere safe; there is no password recovery.
runnerHint: Use the HTTPS address of your desktop runner. Its access controls still apply.
failed: Could not unlock. Check the password and try again.
unavailable: Secure storage is unavailable. Reopen the app in an updated Android WebView.
scope: The lock protects access to the app and encrypts its saved runner connection. Other app preferences and caches are not encrypted.
